import csv, statistics
from collections import defaultdict

info={r[0]:(r[1],r[2]) for r in list(csv.reader(open(CATALOG_CSV)))[1:]}
vals={}
for r in csv.reader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if len(r)!=3: continue
    tid,t,vt=r
    if vt=='value': continue
    try: v=float(vt)
    except: continue
    vals.setdefault(tid,[]).append((t,v))
for k in vals: vals[k].sort()

zt={uri.split('#')[1]:tid for tid,(uri,cls) in info.items() if cls=='Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor'}

# Compare day-to-day variation and correlation with F2 reference for 2018-06-01 to 2018-12-31
target_tid = zt['Zone_F3_Z01.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor']
ref_tid    = zt['Zone_F3_Z02.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor']

tt=dict(vals[target_tid]); rt=dict(vals[ref_tid])
t0='2018-06-01'; t1='2019-01-01'
tt_sub={t:v for t,v in tt.items() if t0<=t<t1}
rt_sub={t:v for t,v in rt.items() if t0<=t<t1}
print("target count:", len(tt_sub), "ref count:", len(rt_sub))
common=sorted(set(tt_sub)&set(rt_sub))
print("common ts:", len(common))
# corr
tx=[tt_sub[t] for t in common]; rx=[rt_sub[t] for t in common]
mx=statistics.mean(tx); my=statistics.mean(rx)
cov=sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(tx,rx))
sx=statistics.pstdev(tx); sy=statistics.pstdev(rx)
corr=cov/(sx*sy)
print("corr between F3_Z01 and F3_Z02 over Jun-Dec 2018: %.3f"%(corr))

# monthly corr
months=set(t[:7] for t in common)
for mo in sorted(months):
    tx=[tt_sub[t] for t in common if t[:7]==mo]
    rx=[rt_sub[t] for t in common if t[:7]==mo]
    if len(tx)<10: continue
    mx=statistics.mean(tx); my=statistics.mean(rx)
    cov=sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(tx,rx))
    sx=statistics.pstdev(tx); sy=statistics.pstdev(rx)
    if sx>0.01 and sy>0.01:
        print(mo, "corr=%.3f"% (cov/(sx*sy)), "target_std=%.2f"%sx, "ref_std=%.2f"%sy, "target_mean=%.2f"%mx, "ref_mean=%.2f"%my)
